chunks: "It is not said in it, 'and He provided us from the livestock of cattle,' for indeed that pertains to the days of Tashrīq."

key_terms.أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ: the days of Tashrīq following Eid al-Adha, during which specific takbir wording is used
key_terms.بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ: the livestock animals; grazing cattle mentioned in sacrificial context
key_terms.رَزَقَنَا: He provided for us; granted sustenance
key_terms.يُقَالُ: is said or recited in the liturgical formula

ai.seo_question: What phrase should not be said in the takbir of Eid al-Fitr, and why?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal restriction concerning the wording of the takbir for Eid al-Fitr. The phrase "and He provided us from the livestock of cattle" should not be included there, because that wording belongs to the days of Tashrīq associated with Eid al-Adha.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "It is not said in it (the Takbir for Eid al-Fitr), 'and He provided us with the livestock of cattle,' as that phrase pertains to the days of Tashreeq (the days following Eid al-Adha)."
